meta.name: product-strategy-session
meta.description: Run an end-to-end product strategy session across positioning, discovery, and roadmap planning. Use when a team needs validated direction before committing to execution.

copy.tagline: 引导团队完成产品定位到路线图的策略规划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队需要为产品找到验证过的方向再开始执行
copy.tagline_en: Run a complete product strategy session from positioning to roadmap
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs validated product direction before building

howto.what: Claude 会引导你完成一个端到端的产品战略流程，包括定位、问题探索、方案设计、路线图规划等环节，帮助你从模糊方向走向可执行的战略。
howto.when: 当你需要为新产品或重大计划制定战略方向，或重新定位现有产品时，可以启动这个流程。

say.text: 帮我规划一个新产品的战略方向。
say.note: Claude 会从定位阶段开始引导。

say.text: 我们团队需要做一次产品定位工作坊。
say.note: Claude 会调用定位工作坊技能。

say.text: 验证一下我们对客户问题的假设。
say.note: Claude 会启动问题发现与验证阶段。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through an end-to-end product strategy process covering positioning, problem exploration, solution design, and roadmap planning, taking you from vague direction to an executable strategy.
howto.when_en: Start this when you need validated direction before committing to execution—e.g., launching a new product, a major initiative, or repositioning an existing product.

say_en.text: Help me plan a strategy for a new product.
say_en.note: Claude starts from the positioning phase.

say_en.text: Run a product positioning workshop for our team.
say_en.note: Claude invokes the positioning workshop skill.

say_en.text: Validate our assumptions about a customer problem.
say_en.note: Claude initiates problem discovery and validation.
